title: diary
description: A diary card compiled from the memories room (ADR-017 §6, record). Its tags are still the topic labels the compile writes (diary_card.canonicalize_topic), which the base's tag rule refuses: the one field no schema here describes as written.

addressee.description: Who the entry speaks to, as said.

entry_id.description: The diary entry, ten hex digits.

media.description: The media archive's files the card embeds.

model.description: The model that read the source.

prompt_template.description: A hash of the prompt's wording the model read the entry under. Moves to the sidecar with the diary (ADR-018, Order step 3).

digest.description: Exception to ADR-017 §8: written outside the serializer, unquoted, so sixteen hex digits that are all digits parse as an integer.
